(u+4)(u-1) = u² + 3u - 4.
(u-3)(u+6) = u² + 3u - 18.

Difference: (u² + 3u - 4) - (u² + 3u - 18) = -4 + 18 = 14.

The correct answer is 14.

Neither is correct. Comparing which is closer, Solution B has the right constant (14) but an erroneous u term, while Solution A has the wrong constant and no variable.
